lessons.title: Use visible Codex helpers while Claude is unavailable
lessons.summary: Until a Claude core session successfully answers a readiness check, route routine helper and review work to a bounded Codex helper in a visible wezterm-tab. Never use headless or hidden model workers.
lessons.review_trigger: A Claude core session successfully responds to a direct readiness check.

lessons.title: All model-backed agents remain operator-visible
lessons.summary: Launch every LLM agent and model-backed helper in a visible terminal, using wezterm-tab by default. Deterministic automation must expose status and controls in Command Center and must open visible sessions for any model judgment.
